note: Licenses read from each project's own repository or official page (2026-10-26). Moderators: skim and approve; verdicts of open_core/unclear/not_open need a decision.

automatisch.note: AGPL-3.0 for everything except files with '.ee.' in the name, which are under a separate enterprise license.

bitwarden.note: GPL-3.0 by default; code in /bitwarden_license is under the proprietary Bitwarden License v1.0.

blender.note: COPYING points to the GPL; source files carry SPDX 'GPL-2.0-or-later'.

budibase.note: 'GPLv3 overall'; packages/pro (paid features) is under BSL; app-runtime packages are MPL-2.0.

cube-js.note: Apache-2.0 by default; some packages carry their own (e.g. MIT) license.

customermates.note: Files outside ee/ are AGPL-3.0-only; ee/ is under a commercial license.

dub.note: AGPL-3.0 except the (ee) directories, under a commercial license.

font-awesome.note: Free edition: icons CC-BY-4.0 (not OSI-approved), fonts SIL OFL-1.1, code MIT. Paid Pro edition is separate. Moderator call. Decision (Oct 27): removed; the free icons are CC-BY-4.0, a content license, not OSI.

gitlab.note: MIT outside ee/ (ee/ is proprietary); docs CC BY-SA 4.0. This repo is the old mirror of the CE edition.

goatcounter.note: 'Slightly modified' EUPL 1.2 (shorter Compatible Licenses list). The modified text is not itself on the OSI list; count.js is ISC. Moderator call. Decision (Oct 27): kept; EUPL-1.2 with a shortened compatible-licenses list is widely treated as open source.

gravitl.note: Apache-2.0 except pro/ directory under a proprietary license.

growthbook.note: MIT except 'enterprise' directories under the GrowthBook Enterprise License.

joplin.note: Apps are AGPL-3.0-or-later; packages/server is under the Joplin Server Personal Use License (not OSI).

keepassxc.note: Offered under GPL v2 or v3 (at your option).

kodi.note: Other licenses apply to some bundled parts (LICENSES/README.md).

lightdash.note: MIT except backend/src/ee, under a commercial license.

mellisearch.note: Core MIT; Enterprise Edition parts under Business Source License 1.1 (LICENSE-EE), not OSI. SPDX: MIT AND BUSL-1.1.

metabase.note: AGPL outside enterprise/; enterprise/ under Metabase Commercial License.

netbird.note: BSD-3-Clause, except management/, signal/, relay/, combined/ (server parts) which are AGPL-3.0; both OSI.

odoo.note: This repo (Community) is LGPL-3.0; Odoo Enterprise is a separate proprietary paid edition (not in this repo; from Odoo's business model, not read in a file).

semi.note: BSD-3-Clause outside the wl/ directory; wl/ is proprietary 'Weaviate License'.

signoz.note: MIT except ee/ and cmd/enterprise/ under a commercial license.

strapi.note: MIT for Community Edition; code under ee/ is the proprietary Enterprise Edition.

supertokens.note: Apache-2.0 except ee/ directory, under its own license.

twenty.note: Mostly AGPL-3.0 (some packages MIT); files marked '@license Enterprise' are commercial.

vendure.note: Dual: GPL-3.0 community edition, or paid Vendure Commercial License.

webiny.note: MIT except enterprise/ directories (own license); packages may have their own LICENSE.

windmill.note: AGPL-3.0 (clients Apache-2.0); 'enterprise' code is proprietary, and the official Community Edition binaries include that proprietary code.

yacy.note: LGPL for source/net/yacy/cora, GPL-2.0-or-later for the rest.

yugabyte.note: Database core Apache-2.0; YugabyteDB Anywhere (managed/) is Polyform Free Trial (not open, 32-day evaluation).

firefox.note: Repo LICENSE points to this file; source headers say MPL-2.0. Firefox name/logo are trademarks.

thunderbird.note: Desktop source file header is MPL-2.0 (repo has no top-level LICENSE file). Thunderbird for Android repo is Apache-2.0.

forgejo.note: README: GPL-3.0-or-later since v9; older versions MIT.

gimp.note: COPYING is the GPL-3 text; source headers say 'version 3 ... or any later version'.

gnumeric.note: Your choice of GPL v2 or GPL v3 (SPDX: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only); both OSI.

inkscape.note: Most source GPL-2.0-or-later; combined binaries are GPL-3.0-or-later. Some third-party libraries LGPL/MPL.

krita.note: README: 'as a whole ... GPL Version 3'; individual files may be GPL-2.0-or-later or other compatible licenses.

libreoffice-calc.note: LibreOffice is one suite (this entry shares the core repo). MPL-2.0 main license; includes parts under LGPL-3.0-or-later and other licenses; based on Apache OpenOffice (Apache-2.0).

libreoffice-impress.note: LibreOffice is one suite (this entry shares the core repo). MPL-2.0 main license; includes parts under LGPL-3.0-or-later and other licenses; based on Apache OpenOffice (Apache-2.0).

libreoffice-writer.note: LibreOffice is one suite (this entry shares the core repo). MPL-2.0 main license; includes parts under LGPL-3.0-or-later and other licenses; based on Apache OpenOffice (Apache-2.0).

arch-linux.note: Distribution of many packages with their own licenses; Arch's own installer (archinstall) is GPL-3.0.

cachyos.note: Distribution of many packages; CachyOS's own tooling (CachyOS-Settings, linux-cachyos kernel packaging) is GPL-3.0.

debian.note: Distribution of many packages under the Debian Free Software Guidelines; debian-installer is GPL-2.0-or-later.

fedora.note: Distribution of many packages; Fedora's installer (anaconda) is GPL (COPYING is GPL v2 text; 'or later' per file headers, not checked).

linux-mint.note: Distribution of many packages; Mint's own tools (e.g. mintupdate) are GPL-3+; Cinnamon is GPL-2.0.

ubuntu.note: Distribution of many packages; the installer is GPL-3.0 (subiquity: AGPL-3.0-or-later for subiquity/ dir, GPL-3.0 otherwise).

grapheneos.note: Android-based OS; mostly Apache-2.0 (AOSP) with GrapheneOS's own components (hardened_malloc, Auditor, Camera) MIT.

lineageos.note: Android-based OS built on AOSP (Apache-2.0); Linux kernel parts GPL-2.0.

e-os.note: Android-based OS built on AOSP (Apache-2.0); /e/ adds its own apps, various licenses.

postmarketos.note: Distribution built on Alpine Linux with many packages; its own tool pmbootstrap is GPL-3.0-or-later.

baserow.note: MIT ('Baserow OSE') outside premium/ and enterprise/, which have their own paid licenses; docs CC BY-SA 4.0.

briar.note: Read from the GitHub mirror because code.briarproject.org did not respond from here.

digikam.note: Source header SPDX GPL-2.0-or-later; COPYING points to LICENSES/GPL-2.0-or-later.txt.

highlight.note: Apache-2.0 except enterprise/ and highlight.io/ directories (own licenses). Not archived; commits as recent as 2026-10-23, and README has no shutdown notice.

inventaire.note: README says 'licensed under AGPLv3'; no LICENSE file was found at the path tried (not archived).

openreplay.note: AGPL-3.0 by default, some directories MIT; ee/ is under a separate enterprise license.

pop-os.note: Distribution (Ubuntu-based) of many packages; Pop!_OS's own installer and shell are GPL-3.0. Its LICENSING.md prefers GPL-3.0-only, MPL-2.0 for libraries.

posthog.note: MIT except ee/, under a separate enterprise license.

rowy.note: Repo not archived but last push 2024-11-23 (inactive ~2 years).

tolgee.note: Apache-2.0 except ee/ and webapp/src/ee, under a separate license.

tor-browser.note: Firefox ESR fork; file header MPL-2.0, repo LICENSE points to that file. Tor and Tor Browser add-ons are BSD-style.

ubuntu-touch.note: Phone OS from many components; UBports' own Lomiri shell is GPL-3.0 (apps/other repos vary).

mpv.note: Fact-check, Oct 27: 'GPL version 2 or later' by default (LGPL-2.1+ when built without GPL-only files).
